note: Signature-independent by design (SKILL.md step 4): a Release build (asserts compiled out) takes the reporter's own 'llvm::cast<X>() argument of incompatible type!' E_FAIL path (0x80004005, text-marker only -- see INTERNAL_MARKERS), while a Debug/assertions build (our ground truth, main-debug) instead traps the maintainer-quoted ScalarReplAggregatesHLSL.cpp RewriteBitCast assertion, exit 0x80000003 or 0xE0000001. is_internal_failure() catches both by exit status first; text is only a backstop for the E_FAIL case. dxc returns E_FAIL for ordinary diagnosed errors too, so 'nonzero exit' alone would be wrong here -- but E_FAIL alone does not satisfy this predicate; only the exit-code allowlist or an INTERNAL_MARKERS text hit does.
